'''Lenc''' was the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of a brutal [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony on [[Weldii III]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he put out a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Smuggler/Legends|gunrunner]] [[Praaelon Di]], after Di provided weapons to both sides of a violent uprising on Weldii III. After two attempts at his capture, one by a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] fleet and one by a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] led by [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], Di traveled to Weldii III with a small force of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and defeated Lenc.
